items.title: A Triumphant Tribute to Latine Visual Culture
items.summary: Forty-six entities displayed zines, academic books, textiles, and artwork — some even made in real time — at the third edition of The Latinx Project’s La Feria.

items.title: Independent Art Fair Purchased by British Conglomerate
items.summary: News that the show was acquired by Informa in 2025 comes after the show’s controversial debut in the landmark Breuer building.

items.title: Discover Carl Sprinchorn at Two Maine Museums This Fall
items.summary: The Ogunquit Museum of American Art and Bates College Museum of Art chronicle the life and work of under-recognized modern artist Carl Sprinchorn.
